social:piasnews-social-bc3195ceb471eb0e:.source_text: Q: What is a realistic target? "I think trying to beat the redbulls is probably the main opportunity. Maybe we can beat the ferraris...but I'm not particularly optimistic. We'll see what we get. I mean, the first few laps of the sprint this morning were chaos so hopefully we can get amongst it and hang on from there."
social:piasnews-social-bc3195ceb471eb0e:.zh: 问：什么是现实的目标呢？“我觉得，试图击败红牛队应该是我们的主要目标。也许我们还有机会战胜法拉利队……不过我并不太乐观。让我们拭目以待吧。今天早上的冲刺阶段情况很混乱，希望我们能设法融入竞争并坚持下去。”

social:piasnews-social-14a17b738b72a4b0:.source_text: Q: On your side of the garage was there some head scratching? "Uh, there was a lot of it. Just struggled a lot with rear grip. We thought we made some pretty sensible changes into qualifying but they just didn't really have the impact we were hoping for I guess. A bit of a surprise as to why it's been so tricky the whole weekend. We've been battling with the balance of the car the whole weekend which normally we feel like lack grip and downforce. This weekend it's been a pretty big handful to drive the car. Hopefully we can see what we can do tomorrow and make it a little bit nicer."
social:piasnews-social-14a17b738b72a4b0:.zh: 问：在车库里，你们那边有没有遇到什么令人头疼的问题呢？“嗯，确实有很多问题。后轮的抓地力一直很差。我们在排位赛中尝试了一些调整，但似乎并没有达到预期的效果。整个周末都面临着各种难题。通常情况下，我们会觉得是汽车的抓地力和下压力不足，但这个周末的情况则完全不同。希望明天能找到解决办法，让情况有所改善。”

social:piasnews-social-69a831ffb2073929:.source_text: Q: Can I ask what you positively found from the start? "I mean our starts all year have been strong. So I think for us that's- I was surprised it was so good but I think that's definitely the positive. Everything else we need to improve a little bit and hopefully we can do that for this afternoon."
social:piasnews-social-69a831ffb2073929:.zh: 问：请问从一开始您就觉得哪些方面是不错的呢？“我的意思是，我们全年的开局都相当不错。所以，我觉得这确实是个积极的方面。当然，还有其他一些方面需要进一步改进，希望我们能在今天下午的比赛中做到这一点。”

social:piasnews-social-1b004cfebb172d7d:.source_text: Q: Bit hard to follow that race! "Yeah, it was pretty chaotic that's for sure! I mean it was very hard to work out what was going on in the car. Trying to avoid crashing into the back of people most of the time so pretty chaotic. I think a few things there's a few things we can do better for sure but we also want to improve the car a bit. We're struggling a little bit. I think the pace looked okay then, just very difficult to get that out of the car."
social:piasnews-social-1b004cfebb172d7d:.zh: 问：那场比赛实在很难理解其进程！“没错，场面确实一片混乱！根本很难弄清楚每辆车的具体情况。大部分时间都得努力避免撞到后面的车，所以整个比赛过程都很混乱。我觉得有一些地方我们还可以做得更好，同时也需要对赛车进行一些改进。我们目前面临一些困难。不过，我觉得赛车的整体表现还算不错，只是很难把赛车的性能完全发挥出来而已。”

social:piasnews-social-2636e89f740ec34f:.zh: “我不确定这个周末我们的成绩会如何，大概能排第三或第四吧。目前就是这个水平。希望我们在匈牙利使用的新型零部件能帮助我们取得更好的成绩。当然，仅仅这些升级还不够，但希望这能是我们迈向成功的第一步。” https://t.co/eImDhIVhLM

social:piasnews-social-af4ae77aaf0151ec:.source_text: Q: How do you rate your chances here and what about the development of the car? "For this weekend, I'm not sure where we're gonna sit. You know, we're going to be similar to where we have been which is probably 3rd or 4th quickest car. Depending on how competitive redbull look really. That's just the reality of where we are at the moment. I think going forwards, yeah, hopefully the new parts we can bring to the car will help us out. We're under no illusion that we're going to need more than the upgrades we're bringing in the next few races. But hopefully it's a positive step in the right direction and we can at least be there to pick up the pieces. Hopefully we can try our best this weekend! See what comes out way and then try and get on the front foot from Budapest onwards."
social:piasnews-social-af4ae77aaf0151ec:.zh: 问：您如何评估自己在这场比赛中的胜算？另外，关于赛车的性能提升方面，您有什么看法？“对于本周末的比赛，我还不确定我们的排名会如何。大概会和以往差不多，处于第三或第四名的位置吧。当然，这也取决于红牛队的表现如何。这就是我们目前的现实情况。希望接下来，我们能够通过更换新的零部件来提升赛车的性能。我们并不指望仅靠这几场比赛中的升级就能取得好成绩。但希望这能是一个积极的开始，至少能让我们有机会取得更好的成绩。希望本周末我们能全力以赴！看看结果如何，然后从布达佩斯开始争取更好的表现。”

social:piasnews-social-63c360613d534587:.zh: 奥斯卡对 2026 年赛车项目的评判如下：“当比赛的资格赛结果由计算机的判断来决定时，这种方式实在糟糕。在资格赛结束后，你查看数据，心想‘我和队友处于同一水平’，但实际上却落后了 2 个十分之一秒。这种感觉真不好受。”https://t.co/52bNLCcyOO

social:piasnews-social-c56254d5fb90e223:.source_text: Had a very short work trip to Shanghai, and as I was checking out of my hotel (wearing an OP81 shirt), one of the employees called out, "Oscar, Oscar!" and showed me her phone screen. 🥹 Not sure what the odds are of this ever reaching her, but I just wanted to say that this short interaction made me so incredibly happy. I only wish I'd worn my shirt earlier so we could've met before today. 🧡
social:piasnews-social-c56254d5fb90e223:.zh: 有一次出差去上海，在退房时（穿着 OP81 恤衫），有个员工叫道：“奥斯卡，奥斯卡！”然后展示了她的手机屏幕给我看。不知道这个消息是否有机会传达到她那里，但我想说，这次短暂的互动让我感到非常开心。真希望我能早一点穿上那件恤衫，这样我们就能在今天之前见面了。🧡

social:piasnews-social-c022782a3dc643c7:.source_text: Q: Could a corner be turned by this upgrade coming in Hungary? "I hope so but I mean the others aren't going to standing still. The others are going to be bringing upgrades as well. Definitely we're a bit inconsistent at the moment. This weekend we did look better. Even yesterday for myself, Q3 there was a power unit anomaly and the rest of my lap was good. Yeah. There's just a lot of things that skew the picture a bit at the moment. I think hopefully we can get on top of those bits first but also some upgrades will definitely help because the car can be quick on a day like today. But extracting the pace out of it is very very tough so hopefully that makes us quicker and a little bit more consistent."
social:piasnews-social-c022782a3dc643c7:.zh: Q：这种升级在匈牙利实施后，是否有可能扭转局面呢？“希望如此，不过其他车队也不会坐以待毙。其他车队也会进行升级。目前我们的表现确实有些不稳定。本周末我们的表现有所改善。甚至昨天，在第三轮比赛中，我的动力单元出现了问题，但其余的赛段表现还不错。不过，目前有很多因素会影响我们的成绩。希望我们能先解决这些问题，同时一些升级肯定会有帮助，因为在这类比赛中，赛车的速度确实很重要。不过要从中找出优势确实非常困难，希望这样能让我们表现得更加稳定。”

social:piasnews-social-b5b699a3c4661f72:.zh: Q：“那和查尔斯的联系呢？”奥斯卡回答：“嗯，我丢失了那个侧板装置……算了，也许我不应该称之为‘侧板’，那只是你放在走廊里的某个东西而已。他的创意真是无可阻挡啊😭😭😭 链接：https://t.co/1RyGX5XGnj

social:piasnews-social-10660a9c55aab58a:.source_text: Q: What about that contact with Charles? "Yeah I lost the side board thing...okay maybe I shouldn't call it a side board, that's something you put in your hallway. I lost parts of my car and I don't know where I was supposed to go. I was equally surprised that nothing came of it. Obviously you know it's small contact. It had big consequences for me. Could've had very big consequences for both of us but it is what it is. I think from then on the race was definitely more difficult. The balance suffered quite a lot for the first stint after that. We were able to compensate a bit in the second stint and the pace got better again but yeah it was just bit of a tricky race from then on."
social:piasnews-social-10660a9c55aab58a:.zh: Q：那次与查尔斯的接触怎么样了？“唉，我丢失了那个侧板装置……其实我不应该称之为‘侧板’，那只是你放在走廊里的某个东西而已。我的汽车也损坏了，我不知道自己应该去哪里。而且，这件事最终并没有什么结果，这让我很惊讶。显然，那只是一次小小的接触而已。但对我来说，这却带来了很大的影响。本来我们俩都可能面临很大的麻烦，但事情就是这样。从那以后，比赛就变得更加艰难了。在比赛的第一阶段，我们的平衡感受到了很大的影响。在第二阶段，我们稍微弥补了一些损失，速度也有所提高。不过，从那以后，比赛确实变得有些棘手了。”

social:piasnews-social-18e993d4f4facb90:.source_text: Q: "you think 4th fastest is now the reality for the team?" oscar: "i think so, we just need a step more. the car was still very tough to drive, and obviously the damage didn't help. it might've been quick, but it was still very tough." https://t.co/zWCt0KodH5
social:piasnews-social-18e993d4f4facb90:.zh: Q：“你认为成为第四快的车队现在已经成为现实了吗？” Oscar：“我觉得是的，我们只需要再进步一点而已。那辆车仍然非常难以驾驶，而且损坏的情况显然也影响了性能。虽然速度可能不错，但操控性仍然很差。” https://t.co/zWCt0KodH5

social:piasnews-social-82e51e7425fe6c7d:.source_text: Q: "after a difficult race in silverstone how important was it for you to have a good race here?" oscar: "it was important, although it wasn't a clean race. i think we were a bit more competitive today which was nice to see. that's the biggest positive from the weekend." https://t.co/MPqOwXr0P6

social:piasnews-social-c12414f05c016107:.source_text: Q: This is your favourite track, talk us through what makes it so enjoyable "I mean, there's just a lot of cool stuff about it. The locations pretty unique, in the middle of the forest, lots of elevation change. A lot of unique corners as well, maybe some of them aren't quite what they used to be this year but it's just an awesome track. Overtaking normally been pretty good here, the races so we'll see what we get this year. It's a cool place to be going racing."
social:piasnews-social-c12414f05c016107:.zh: Q：这是你最喜欢的赛道，能详细说说为什么它如此令人愉悦吗？“嗯，这个赛道有很多很棒的地方。赛道的位置非常独特，位于森林中，地势变化很大。还有很多独特的弯道。不过，有些弯道今年可能不太像以前了，但总体来说，这确实是一条很棒的赛道。在这里超车通常都很轻松，今年的情况我们拭目以待吧。这里真是适合进行赛车比赛的地方。”

social:piasnews-social-f0ee71948ed01a59:.source_text: Q: : Do you feel the car has the pace to challenge in this race? "I think hopefully with Ferrari we can do something and with Max as well. We'll have to wait and see. We're in a different category to Mercedes at the moment but we'll see what we can do. The first lap could be interesting so hopefully we can get involved and see what we can do."
social:piasnews-social-f0ee71948ed01a59:.zh: Q：你觉得这辆车的速度足以在本次比赛中挑战强者吗？“希望与法拉利一起，我们能取得好成绩。当然，还有马克斯也在帮助我们。我们得等待看看结果。目前我们比梅赛德要处于更有利的地位，但我们会努力看看自己能做到什么。首轮比赛可能会很有趣，希望我们能参与其中，看看自己能取得怎样的成绩。”

social:piasnews-social-97dc968910879796:.source_text: Q: what was missing out there? "Just...just speed. Its not been particularly easy all weekend to be honest. Struggling with the balance of the car but yeah today in particular has been a pretty big grind to get any lap time out of it. Not an easy day but we'll see what we can do tomorrow."
social:piasnews-social-97dc968910879796:.zh: Q：那里缺少了什么？“就是……就是速度。说实话，整个周末的比赛都非常艰难。车辆的平衡问题一直困扰着我，今天尤其如此，要获得任何排位时间都相当不容易。这不是轻松的一天，但让我们看看明天能做什么吧。”

social:piasnews-social-2b8f96035255c9f8:.source_text: the distressed smile 😭😭 Q: What sort of race pace is there in the car? "We don't really know. We didn't really do that many laps in FP2 in terms of race running so it's very hard to read where we are. The pact around us is very tight but we're probably just at the back of it. We'll see what we can do but it's not going to be easy."
social:piasnews-social-2b8f96035255c9f8:.zh: 那痛苦的笑容😭😭 问：赛车中的速度水平如何？“我们其实不清楚。在第二次练习赛中，我们并没有跑过太多圈数，所以很难判断我们的位置。周围的其他赛车都非常紧逼，但我们可能只是排在最后几位。我们会看看自己能做什么，但这不会容易。”

social:piasnews-social-7311380480d6655d:.source_text: Q: Has it been a little bit of a battle to find comfort in the car this weekend? "Yeah. It's been a bit of a struggle. I think it started okay in FP1 but then yesterday, we had an issue. So I missed a little bit of FP2 but even the laps I did were tricky. Then today, it's been the same story. Eventually it was a little bit more respectable but it's been a tough weekend that's for sure."
social:piasnews-social-7311380480d6655d:.zh: Q：这个周末在赛车中寻找安慰的过程是不是有点艰难呢？“是的，确实挺困难的。我觉得在第一节排位赛中情况还算不错，但昨天出现了问题。所以我在第二节排位赛中表现不佳，即使那些圈数还算不错，但环境也很复杂。今天也是同样的状况。最终，我的表现稍微好了一些，但总的来说，这确实是一个艰难的周末。”

social:piasnews-social-5436e2bcb9b40a7f:.source_text: Q: What's your best hope in where you can finish in qualifying? "I don't know yet. I think the Ferraris have looked very quick in both sessions. Lando looked competitive in that one especially. Yeah I think the Mercedes is very hard to read. Let's wait and see tomorrow but I think if we execute a good day then it seems there can be a lot up for grabs."
social:piasnews-social-5436e2bcb9b40a7f:.zh: Q：您在排位赛中的最佳期望是什么？“我还不知道。我觉得两场排位赛中的法拉利赛车都表现非常迅速。尤其是兰多，他的表现相当有竞争力。嗯，梅赛德赛车的情况也很难预测。让我们拭目以待，但如果我们能够度过一个出色的比赛日，那么很有可能获得更好的成绩。”

social:piasnews-social-837f4cf11fd1c697:.source_text: Q: How on top of the new parts did you get with only one session? "I didn't have them today. I think on Landos car, they've been working as expected which is good. I don't think they've completely changed the car which obviously we weren't expecting but, would've been nice. We'll see what it's like on my car tomorrow and hopefully we can have a successful day!"
social:piasnews-social-837f4cf11fd1c697:.zh: Q：在只进行了一次试驾的情况下，新的部件究竟带来了怎样的效果呢？“今天我没有使用它们。我觉得在 Lando 的车上，这些部件的表现如预期般良好，这很不错。虽然这些部件并没有完全改变车辆的性能，显然我们并没有预料到这种情况，不过，如果能有这样的表现就好了。明天我会再试驾一下我的车，希望今天能有一个成功的试驾体验！”

social:piasnews-social-6daaba46df4aa323:.source_text: Q: How did you assess FP2? "Very very challenging for sure. I think the track conditions are pretty challenging out there. Very windy, the new parts of the track are...not very grippy. And kind of, not breaking apart but they're very wore so just a very challenging circuit at the moment. Obviously missing a practice sessions made it pretty tough."
social:piasnews-social-6daaba46df4aa323:.zh: Q：您对 FP2 赛道的评价如何？ “确实非常具有挑战性。我觉得赛道条件相当苛刻。风很大，赛道上的新部分也不太适合高速行驶。而且赛道表面磨损严重，整体来说就是个非常具有挑战性的赛道。显然，因为无法参加练习赛，所以比赛难度更大了。”

social:piasnews-social-8b6acc4749841a7c:.source_text: 🚨 Oscar Piastri on if he feels he's the passenger of an AI program when it comes to the PUs "Sometimes, yes. ...The principle of driving a race car that loses effectively half of its power before the end of the straight is hard to get your head around sometimes." "Even in Spa, a lot of the middle sector we were doing it just on the combustion engine, with no battery assistance at all, which is a weird feeling in itself, having some corners with a certain amount of power & others with full power. I think Spa was particularly frustrating, not just for me but for quite a lot of others, because those small differences in the code & what the engines did made quite a big difference in lap time. Especially at the front of the field, I think there were still only 9 hundredths or something separating 4 positions & there were definitely more than 9 hundredths on the table for quite a few drivers with nothing they could control."
social:piasnews-social-8b6acc4749841a7c:.zh: 🚨 奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里谈到 PUs 时表示：“有时候，确实如此……驾驶一辆在直线赛道结束前就损失了一半动力的赛车，这种感觉确实很难理解。甚至在斯帕赛道上，我们很多比赛都是只使用内燃机，没有电池辅助，这种感觉本身就很奇怪。有些弯道能获得一定的动力，而有些则完全没有动力。我觉得斯帕赛道特别令人沮丧，不仅对我如此，对很多人来说也是如此，因为代码中的一些小差异以及发动机的工作方式，会极大地影响单圈时间。尤其是在赛道的靠前位置，当时只有 9 百分之一左右的差距就能决定 4 名车手的排名，而有些车手拥有的动力优势则远远超过 9 百分之一，但他们却无法控制这种差异。”

social:piasnews-social-9e5ea9ff397ab1d2:.source_text: Q: What is the mindset now going into the summer break? "I mean, just try and reset and find some pace is the biggest thing. But on the strategy side, you don't plan a strategy for getting taken out by a back marker. So I can't blame the team at all for that. Just try and improve over the break, have a bit of time to reset and come back again."
social:piasnews-social-9e5ea9ff397ab1d2:.zh: Q：现在进入夏季休息期时，我们应该保持什么样的心态呢？“我的意思是，尽量重新调整状态，找到适合自己的节奏是最重要的。不过在策略方面，我们并没有为可能被竞争对手超越的情况做好准备。所以，我完全不责怪团队。只是在这段休息时间里努力提升自己，花些时间来调整状态，然后再回来继续比赛。”

social:piasnews-social-ec1371731e45d2ff:.source_text: Q: Were you disappointed to be pitted into traffic? Or was it the timing of the stop? "No I mean I was more pissed off about being crashed into by Carlos. In the moment I was hoping, maybe, they would not pit Lando because of that incident to at least give me the chance to stay in the lead but I think that's not very reasonable. I was more very upset in the moment about what had happened. I think the timing of my pitstop was fine. We wanted to beat Lewis and that's what we needed to do to do that."
social:piasnews-social-ec1371731e45d2ff:.zh: Q：被安排进入赛道进行进站时，你感到失望了吗？还是因为进站的时间安排问题？ “不，我更生气的是被卡洛斯撞到了这件事。在那一刻，我真心希望他们不会让兰多进入赛道，这样我就能继续保持领先。不过我觉得那样做不太合理。当时我真的很为所发生的事而难过。不过我觉得我的进站时机还是不错的。我们想超越刘易斯，而这也是我们必须做的事情。”

social:piasnews-social-df5bfffd16ac6ffe:.source_text: Q: How pleased we're you with the start? "Uh yeah, that was definitely the highlight of my race and it went pretty downhill from there. I mean a lot of things to unpack. I think firstly, the pace on the hard tyres was just nowhere. And then getting taken out by a back marker never really something you think can go wrong but I was proven wrong. And then obviously the gearbox so um not the easiest of days."
social:piasnews-social-df5bfffd16ac6ffe:.zh: Q：对比赛的开局情况，你们满意吗？“嗯，那确实是我比赛中的亮点时刻，不过之后的情况就变得比较糟糕了。其实有很多事情需要分析。首先，使用硬胎时的速度实在非常慢。然后，被后面的赛车超越也并不是什么好事，但我显然错了。当然，还有变速箱的问题，真是糟糕的一天啊。”

social:piasnews-social-91d9c1c53ac7b7e8:.source_text: Q: How important is it from a confidence POV to finish with a strong result before the summer break? "It's important for sure. But either eay, we're gonna enjoy the break and take some time to reset. But to be able to go into it with a bit of momentum and some happier vibes would be a nice thing ☺️"
social:piasnews-social-91d9c1c53ac7b7e8:.zh: Q：从信心建设的角度来看，在夏季假期之前取得一个好的成绩有多重要？“当然很重要了。不过，我们也可以选择好好享受假期，花些时间调整状态。能够带着一些积极的势头和愉悦的氛围进入假期，会是一件很棒的事情☺️”

social:piasnews-social-84e00a17ccbef6b1:.source_text: Q: Can you get in the mix for the fight for the win? "I think so, yes. Obviously one of the cars to beat is papaya, not red so we'll see what we can do. We're definitely looking stronger here than we have done, especially the last few races so I'm confident we can well and truly fight."
social:piasnews-social-84e00a17ccbef6b1:.zh: Q：你们能参与到这场争夺胜利的比赛中吗？“我觉得可以。显然，需要击败的赛车之一就是帕帕亚，不过红车也不容小觑，所以我们会努力看看能做什么。现在的状态肯定比以往要好，尤其是在最近的几场比赛中，所以我相信我们有很大的机会赢得胜利。”

social:piasnews-social-fc5a03a4743b2fcc:.source_text: Q: Considering everything, P3 on the grid isn't too bad "Yeah definitely. It's not been the easiest of weekends but starting third is a good effort so far. I was a bit annoyed after qualifying, not being able to do the last lap but I gained 2 positions since then anyway so it's going okay. The race is gonna be interesting today. It's pretty windy, the tracks a lot hotter than we had on Friday as well so I'm excited to see what we can do."
social:piasnews-social-fc5a03a4743b2fcc:.zh: Q：综合考虑各方面的情况，排在第 3 名其实也不错吧？“当然了。这周末的比赛并不轻松，但能排到第三已经很不错了。排位赛结束后我有点恼火，因为无法参加最后一圈比赛，不过之后还是取得了 2 个名次上的提升，所以情况还算不错。今天的比赛一定会很有趣。天气很潮湿，赛道的温度也比周五时要高很多，所以我很期待能看到怎样的比赛结果。”

social:piasnews-social-1ab4f7a5b679a1bb:.source_text: On missing FP1 and feeling like he's playing catch up: "That's definitely not helped, for sure. But the wind conditions have been quite different today so it's a bit of a reset in some ways. I feel like I've been chasing it all weekend to an extent so yeah. I feel like I need another few practice sessions to really get on top of things which we don't have."
social:piasnews-social-1ab4f7a5b679a1bb:.zh: 关于错过第一次练习赛以及感觉自己需要追赶前面的车手的情况，他说：“这肯定没有起到任何帮助作用。不过，今天的天气条件与以往不同，某种程度上可以说是一种重新开始的机会。我觉得自己整个周末都在努力追赶前面的车手，所以确实需要再练习几次才能真正赶上他们。不过，我们目前还没有那么多练习机会。”

social:piasnews-social-078bd013fe5554e8:.source_text: Q: Oscar you were affected by the yellow flags. Overall was there much more in the car? "I mean it was just Lewis not looking in his mirrors. The yellow flag wasn't my problem. A shame because it meant I didn't get a lap in either way but clearly the cars been quick today. I've certainly been chasing it. It's not been easy but clearly there's performance there."
social:piasnews-social-078bd013fe5554e8:.zh: Q：奥斯卡，你受到了“黄旗”信号的影响。总体来说，赛车里有哪些改进呢？“我的意思是，只是刘易斯没有注意看后视镜。黄旗信号并不是我的问题。可惜的是，这意味着我无论如何都无法完成一圈比赛。不过显然，今天的赛车速度很快。我当然也在努力追赶他们。这并不容易，但显然赛车性能有了提升。”

social:piasnews-social-fc8be0decd68d595:.source_text: Q: How are you feeling right now? "Obviously pretty disappointed. I feel like lap 1 was good. The first stint is general was reasonable, I felt and then struggled for pace on the hard. But even with that, the pace was pretty good I felt like. Uh sorry. The pace was not good but I had track position. I felt like even though I was struggling, I could hang on. But from that point onwards, pretty much everything that could've gone wrong did."
social:piasnews-social-fc8be0decd68d595:.zh: Q：你现在感觉如何？“显然非常失望。我觉得第一圈的表现还不错。前半段的赛道状况还算合理，我的感觉还不错。不过在难度的路段上，速度有所下降。不过，即便如此，我的速度还是相当不错的。呃，抱歉，速度并不是很好，但我还是保持了较好的赛道位置。虽然有些困难，但我仍然能够跟住其他人。但从那之后，几乎所有可能出现的问题都发生了。”
